extracted.name: Bubble & squeak Boxing Day brunch
extracted.description: Rustle up this vegan bubble & squeak brunch with the veggie leftovers from your Christmas Day dinner. Perfect for a lazy start to Boxing Day
instruction_lines: Roughly mash your cold paprika roasties with a fork, then add the leftover cabbage, cumin seeds, garlic and some seasoning, and mix together. Use your hands to shape the mixture into two patties.

Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Fry the patties for 3-4 mins each side until crisp. Or heat an air fryer to 200C. Brush the patties with a little oil and cook in the basket for 8-10 mins, flipping over after 5 mins, until hot throughout. Pour the lemon juice over the avocado. Serve the patties with avocado, a sprinkling of chilli flakes and a good pinch of flaky sea salt.
